# Kraken fixtures (Octopus Energy France)

Answers of the Kraken GraphQL API of Octopus Energy France, in the shapes the
code and the tests of
[ha-octopus-french](https://github.com/domodom30/ha-octopus-french) (MIT)
read: `obtainKrakenToken`, `viewer.accounts`, `account` (ledgers, properties,
supply points, agreements and rates), the error lists (`KT-CT-1135` refusal,
`KT-CT-1199` rate limit, `KT-CT-1124` expired token).

Everything is made up: account, ledger and supply point numbers, product
codes and amounts. The daily measurements are generated by
`test/helpers/kraken-server.js` in the same shape (string values, euro cents in
`costInclTax.estimatedAmount`, an `ABONNEMENT` statistic). The exact error
codes and type names are to be confirmed by `scripts/probe.mjs` against the
live API.
